Are they right? Or are they wrong? Please enlighten me with a detailed answer. 5788 views Q. My question with regards to the Adab of Mosque/ Mussalah. We have a small mussalah in our suburb. After every salat, we do some talim. During the talim, we see that some of the brothers who joined the jamat late, they are still praying their fardth salat. And also, some brothers are praying their sunnah. what should we do? do we need to wait for those brothers? or start the talim immediately after the salat? Does this act effact salat of the other muslim brothers? Whether we become sinners or not? Same problem arises, when make "allan" for jula or Gasth. These kind of questions are killing for years. Personally, I have realised this problem. Because, sometimes I catch the jamat little late. Before finishing my salat, "allan'' or "talim" starts. Then it become to hard to concentrate on the salat. Sometimes, I can not join the talim because I have to go to my jobs. Therefore, I have to pray sunnah quickly. As the place is not too big, i can hear the sound. answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> Dawah & Tableeg Question ID: 7437 Country: Saudi Arabia Title: Assalamoalikum warahmatullah wabarakatuh!! Respected Ulalam ikram...I once got to chat with a person who happens to b a salafi and says that going in jamat is a biddah.My father mashAllah happens to be a person who has a regular routine of going in jamat and i know very well that this work is the greatest of all deeds and one of the big sunnahs.I said that its just a setup to practice and he told me a story and a jist of a hadith.He said Once sahaba karam RAdiyallahu anhum Ajma'een were sitting in the masjid in a circle and were counting tasbeeh (subahanAllah,Alhamdulillah and Allahuakbar) each 100 times on small pebbles. Hazrat Omar Bin Khatab Radiyallhu Anhu saw those sahabah and went to RAsulullah SAW and told what he saw.RAsulullah SAW said that they are counting there sins. That person says...those sahabah were doing Zikr..and with a good intention..Y did Rasulullah SAW said that.In reference to that...he says that going in jamat is a biddah Can u kindly provide a solid and strong answer to prove that its not a biddah and biggest of all sunnah... wssaalam!! That person says...those sahabah were doing Zikr..and with a good intention..Y did Rasulullah SAW said that.In reference to that...he says that going in jamat is a biddah Can u kindly provide a solid and strong answer to prove that its not a biddah and biggest of all sunnah... wssaalam!! Answer ID: 7437 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1694/1679=D/1429) ادع الى سبيل ربك بالحكمة Tabligh and preaching is proved by this verse and other verses of the Holy Quran as well the Hadith. All the Prophets ( عليهم السلام ) especially the last Prophet Muhammad ( صلى الله عليه وسلم ) invited people to Allah Almighty, so how can preaching be bid?ah (innovation in the religion)? This is the Sunnah of Prophets. Also, it is Sunnah of the Prophet Muhammad ( صلى الله عليه وسلم ) and the Sahaba ( رضوان الله عليهم ) to go to villages for preaching. For this very purpose, the Prophet ( صلى الله عليه وسلم ) used to send a group of some Sahaba. Therefore, how can it be bid'ah be in group and go for preaching and doing tabligh . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
